lines.text: What are you coming in with today?
I'm coming in with a sore left knee from netball on Saturday.
Um, I mean the right knee, not the left one.
I tell a lie, it was at netball on Sunday, not Saturday.
Did it start with a twist or a knock?
A twist, landing from a jump.
Let me have a look at the right knee now.
It's pretty tight around the kneecap, so I'll do some massage there today.
I'll send you some exercises for the quads as well.
